Job Title: Growth Product Manager
Company: UrbanClap / Urban Company
Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

About the Role:
We are seeking a Growth Product Manager to own customer acquisition and onboarding funnels. You will work closely with marketing, design, and engineering to scale our marketplace.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead growth experiments, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization across the user journey.
• Own PRD creation, user stories, wireframing, and product roadmap for the onboarding team.
• Leverage SQL, Mixpanel, and Google Analytics to uncover funnel drop-offs and retention levers.
• Work in fast-paced Agile / Scrum sprints with engineering and design.

Requirements:
• 2-4 years of experience in product management or growth product roles.
• Strong analytical thinking with hands-on proficiency in SQL, A/B testing, and funnel analysis.
• Bachelor's degree in engineering or related technical field.
• Experience in consumer tech or marketplace startups is strongly preferred.
